description: Who opened a report and how they read it, as its editors see under Views in the app: each person's visits, time spent and whether they opened it since its last successful run, who it is shared with but hasn't opened it since, and how far into it people read, slide by slide. Editors' own time editing doesn't count. Only its editors may.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: getReportViews
title: Get report views
